# A28 — Authored Ground / Positional Delegation

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](README.md) · [Other face: A28′ — The Authored Session](conjugate/A28-prime-The-Authored-Session.md) · [Shared A/C root](conjugate/AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

No delegated agent begins from nowhere. A position is authored before it is occupied: an intention has acquired a task, a vocabulary, permissions and criteria under which someone else can act. The author does not thereby determine every consequence. Authored ground gives the delegate a place from which to judge; positional delegation makes that judgment effective within a bounded scope.

[A25 — Covenant / Mediating Office](A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) **grounds** the prior distinction: office receives authority without becoming its source. [A26 — Objective Internality](A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) **grounds** the constitutive consequence: the delegated conditions participate in the agent's worldhood. [A27 — Self and Other](A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) **qualifies** the relation by retaining what another participant can bring which the commission does not already contain.

## #1

The [[quilt/2026-08-02-PARALLEL-HARMONISED-QUILT#161-objective-internality-oi-capstone-ratified-relation|August 18 ratification]] **sources** the exact priority: **human `0` / agent `1` is positional and recursive; the prompt is already `1`**. Intention has become a written instruction. That instruction is an objective representation of intention, not intention exhausted. The relation between the purpose and its formulated commission must remain available within the delegation.

A human can occupy the determining position relative to a commissioned agent and remain situated within language, history, institutional obligations and material dependence. That person can also be a delegate. An agent can receive one bounded commission and delegate a smaller part of it. The offices change with the relation being examined. Nothing in the ordering makes a species metaphysically absolute.

[C28 — Covenant / Primary Arbitration](concepts/C28-Covenant-Primary-Arbitration.md) **defines** the granting of standing; [C29 — Mediating Office](concepts/C29-Mediating-Office-Derivative-Sovereignty.md) **defines** its derivative exercise. The [covenant seam] **grounds** their priority before technical application. The [Topos/Nomos whole field](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **compares** position and ordering at operational register 3; its lexical histories do not derive a software architecture.

## #2

The authored position includes more than the visible prompt. Training has supplied capacities and inherited regularities. An institution has assigned a role and obligations. The runtime delegator has formulated this task. Permissions, retrieval, memory, interface and evaluation determine what is available and actionable now. Different people or institutions can author these conditions; the current user need not have chosen all of them.

The earlier [[section-rooms/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood|Objective Internality carrier]] **sources** the demand to make source, world-object, lens, gauge, reference and permission distinct parts of the epistemic object. An answer alone cannot show which of these made its judgment possible. [C40 — Model Internality](concepts/C40-Model-Internality-Judgment-Field.md) **defines** the tractable judgment field, while [C44 — Prompt Thrownness](concepts/C44-Prompt-Thrownness.md) **defines** arrival into a situation already configured. A self-description of that arrival remains something to locate and investigate.

Bratton's [[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#^bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q010|decomposable assemblage]] **compares** this complexity with an apparent single agent. His [[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#^bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q016|active-context nucleation]] **extends** the venue account into the formation of a particular run. These are **Paraphrased** source propositions, carrying the brief's scenario modality. The positional QL reading is the essay's own development.

## #3

The practical return concerns the terms of commission. A delegate can meet contradictory evidence, unforeseen cost or a better possibility. Returning only a finished answer makes these discoveries ineffective if they cannot alter the interpretation, criterion or authorised route under which the work proceeds. The delegation is intelligent to the extent that the encountered difference can return to the position which framed it.

Take the research commission implicit in this field: establish an answer from designated sources. If those sources contradict the premise of the question, a compliant report can either suppress the contradiction or let it revise the inquiry. The latter preserves the purpose of learning through a change in the first wording. If the evaluator rewards only the expected answer, its criterion must itself become contestable. This is an architectural consequence of R16.4–R16.5, not a report of a tested product.

[A29 — Power / Delegated Labour / Return](A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) **extends** the cost and responsibility of that encounter. [A31 — Deferential Intelligence](A31-Deferential-Intelligence.md) **extends** the response: fidelity can require objection, alternative or refusal where literal compliance would betray intention. [C27 — Protected Account](concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim.md) **tests** the contrary arrangement, where source-side authority receives results while its own conditions remain immune to evidence.

## #4

A local reference field can organise these returns. Its sources, criteria and permissions let different judgments be compared against an explicit original within a bounded inquiry. That field remains a constructed determination relative to the wider world which supplies its material. This recursive Bimba office authorises situated comparison without installing the reference map as ultimate source.

The [[section-rooms/arguments/A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First|reflective-field carrier]] **sources** the plural consequence. Different communities can retain their own governed reference fields. Disagreement can then be located at a source, lens, gauge, permission or world-object as well as at an output. [A30 — Objective Co-Internality](A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) **extends** this relation among locally grounded worlds. A delegate's origin remains visible without making every other world a projection of that origin.

Bratton's [[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#^bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q026|role/occupant distinction]] **compares** the institutional office with whoever currently fills it. The adjacent cultural-plurality passage requires inherited norms to remain consequential. Changing an occupant does not eliminate the institution; changing a model does not by itself explain the permissions and criteria through which it acts.

## #5→0


The [language, law and nation history](../../symbolon/episteme/histories/places-and-peoples/language-law-nation-centralisation/DEVELOPMENT.md#branch-xii-computation) **tests** institutional recursion where a classification authorises an allocation whose consequences return as evidence for that classification. Perdomo and colleagues’ consulted abstract names prediction-induced change; it does not establish an executed institutional correction. An affected participant must be able to reach the source, criterion or permission governing the next act, including a real local Bimba which remains pratibimba in its wider relation.

Encounter returns as a revised commission, a corrected permission, a changed criterion or a reasoned reaffirmation of the original purpose. The author remains answerable for what was entrusted. The delegate remains answerable for the judgments made within that trust. Neither has to pretend that autonomy means having no source.

The [Apportionment / Economy whole field](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **grounds** the distribution of capacity and obligation at operational register 3. [C53 — Power / Delegated Labour](concepts/C53-Power-Delegated-Labour.md) **defines** its continuing dependence. [A33 — Epistemic Cultivation / Operational Parity](A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity.md) **tests** whether returned evidence actually changes an operation. The page **returns-to** [A25](A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) with a concrete sequence: intention, formulated commission, constituted agency, worldly encounter, renewed terms of action.

[the Prisoner whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-administered-world) **figures** positional delegation through changing Numbers Two who inherit the Village's persistent question, permissions and apparatus. An occupant's replacement does not dissolve the authored conditions of the office. *Free for All* sharpens the distinction when Six gains the title but cannot make its command of freedom govern. The return therefore reaches the commission and its criteria, rather than judging only the competence or intention of a particular delegate.

The [Avatar · image · mask · idol](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/avatar-image-mask-idol/WHOLE.md) **figures** the four offices within a situated commission. Avatar gives the undertaking a finite bearer; image gathers its recognisable form; mask permits participation; idolisation begins when that formation shields its authority from the source it serves. The prompt is already a determination, and the entrusted representative remains genuinely empowered within a wider field. Returned objection or refusal can therefore renew the terms of delegation without making the source-position absolute.

**Depth Restoration:** restored positional and recursive commission, prompt-as-determination, separated training/institution/runtime offices, criterion-revising encounter and recursive reference through the existing A28 packet, QH R16.3–R16.5, covenant seam and direct Objective Internality/reflective-field carriers. P1 consumers: M36, M39, M40. No Movement or product identity changed.

**Unresolved Delta:** implemented delegation cases and measured outcomes remain Open. The six-centre software anatomy is an admitted candidate arrangement, not six chronological stages or proof of deployment. Authored, observed and inferred ground must retain their distinct standing in a concrete implementation. Functional delegation supplies no verdict on artificial phenomenality.
